outcome_values_inspected_before_freeze: none; only finite-row counts of model inputs and of the 24h target were read (coverage audit 2026-11-13T11:16:01Z), and no metric, coefficient, prediction, or target distribution statistic was computed
claim: The sealed FCLR-011 funding-conditioned volatility PASS (C2 vs B1, +4.94% relative QLIKE reduction, 5 instruments, 3 blocks, 2026-05..2026-08) does NOT replicate on the disjoint, never-tested 2026-01..2026-04 rolling-origin walk-forward over the contiguous funding-backed cached window 2025-05..2026-04 (train start 2025-05-01). A CONFIRMED verdict requires >=2% relative QLIKE reduction with a 95% day-block bootstrap CI excluding zero on the improving side, >=5 instruments, >=3 non-overlapping test blocks, Holm across the declared family, LOIO >=4/5, funding-permutation placebo PASS, and a leakage audit PASS.

why_this_is_new.problem_with_prior_period_tests: Every prior funding-conditioned volatility period test is either the sealed FCLR-011 window (2026-05..2026-08), the forward 2026-08..2026-10 confirmation (NOT_REPLICATED), the 2025-02..2025-05 cross (NOT_REPLICATED, rel 0.29%), the 2024-07-23..2024-09-30 cross (NOT_REPLICATED, rel -20.77%), or the 2025-07-23..2025-10-15 cross (NOT_REPLICATED, rel -8.97%). The 2026-01..2026-04 test block has never been used.
why_this_is_new.untested_window: The cached Binance archive holds complete hourly mark/premium/index klines and 8-hourly funding for the five FCLR-011 symbols over 2025-05..2026-04. The 2026-01..2026-04 test blocks are disjoint from every tested window and fully materialized on disk (coverage audit 2026-11-13T111601Z: 42624 model-ready rows, 5 symbols x >=3600 rows per block, train 238/269/299 days).
why_this_is_new.not_a_relitigation: The sealed FCLR-011 artifact is not mutated or re-scored. This is a new period with identical models, metric, contrasts, and gate structure, so the null can be broken on genuinely fresh out-of-sample evidence.
why_this_is_new.no_label_use: No liquidation label is consumed. This arm is volatility-only.
why_this_is_new.separation: No test hour in 2026-01..2026-04 overlaps 2024-07-23..2024-09-30, 2025-02..2025-05, 2025-07..2025-10, 2026-05..2026-08, or 2026-08..2026-10 at any timestamp. Train start 2025-05-01 is before all test blocks; each block has a 7-day embargo between train end and test start. Train history may overlap the earlier 2025-07..2025-10 period as legitimate pre-test history; only the test blocks must be disjoint from previously evaluated outcomes.

splits.design: rolling-origin walk-forward; each block refits on all data up to its train_end; 7-calendar-day embargo between train end and test start
splits.block_rule: Three non-overlapping test blocks, each preceded by a 7-day embargo. No padding, no imputation, and no test rows are dropped for missing inputs.
splits.train_span_note: Training span grows per block (~238 / ~269 / ~299 days).

gates.ci_method: day-block bootstrap over UTC days, pooled across blocks
gates.holm_family: all horizon x contrast x block cells
gates.loio_note: leave one instrument out of training, evaluate on the held-out instrument
gates.placebo_rule: permute signed_funding and abs_fund_pct within symbol; true relative reduction must exceed the null 95th percentile
gates.leakage_rule: every feature strictly causal at t; target strictly forward; 7-day embargo between train end and test start

verdict_rule.CONFIRMED: materiality_ge_2pct AND ci_excludes_zero_improving AND holm_pass AND loio_ge_4_of_5 AND placebo_pass AND leakage_audit_pass AND instruments_ge_5 AND blocks_ge_3
verdict_rule.FRAGILE: materiality_ge_2pct AND ci_excludes_zero_improving but LOIO or placebo FAIL
verdict_rule.NOT_REPLICATED: materiality FAIL or CI includes zero
verdict_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: instruments < 5 or blocks < 3 or leakage FAIL or no finite primary rows

forbidden: threshold shopping or feature changes after outcome inspection
reusing an inspected window as a fresh confirmation
declaring a volatility PASS for H1_primary without the confirmatory gate
reusing an execution whose training span was empty (such a run is void, not evidence)

coverage_audit.note: Coverage + train feasibility only: finite-row counts and train-span arithmetic. No outcome statistic computed. Every block has >=5 instruments and >=3600 test rows.

universe.rule: the five FCLR-011 symbols, restricted to the contiguous cached months 2025-05..2026-04 with complete mark/premium/index klines and funding
